verdict.rationale: AWS documents official getting-started material: a recommended set of six onboarding tasks for beginners, plus tutorials to build and deploy a React app with Amplify or host a simple website. That shows first-party quickstarts that reach a deployed service. However, the evidence never shows the exact commands in those tutorials or any time-to-first-deploy figure. Missing for 10: evidence that the quickstarts show exact copy-paste commands, evidence that first deploy takes under an hour, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown

citations.quote: If you're a beginner looking for a starting point to learn AWS, we recommend that you complete the following six onboarding tasks.
Learn how to build and deploy a React web application with user authentication, a database, and storage using AWS Amplify.
Learn how to host your personal or simple marketing website on AWS.
